description: Read the current state of a message sent with a key of the same project. Poll only while `status` is `queued` or `submitted`: `delivered`, `undeliverable` and `failed` are final, and `unknown` never changes. Wait about 2 seconds before the first read and double the wait each time, up to 30 seconds. Always set a time limit (two minutes is generous for a test message); when it passes, treat the message as unconfirmed and do not send it again.

api_key.description: An sk_test_ key, for example from create_test_key. Leave it out to use the key in this MCP server's Authorization header. A live key (sk_live_) is refused here: tool arguments are kept in the conversation, so a live key belongs in the header.

message_id.description: The message `id` from send_message, such as msg_01J8….

name: get_message
title: Read a message's status
